translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Romanos
book.title: Kart daa bzej Páblona' na' bseḻeen lao beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona' yell Rómana'

content: Na' cho' ba zoac̱hec̱hcho chonḻilall'cho Chioza', chiyaḻ' gapcho yeḻ' chxenlall' c̱he beṉ'ka' biṉ' gakcha, na' bi chiyaḻ' gonzcho daa cheenzicho goncho.
To tocho chiyaḻ' goncho dii gaklenan bish' ljwellchoka' kwenc̱he gakchagake'.
Ḻa' Crístona' aga bene' daa wyazlall' to kwinze', san gok c̱he' ka na Cho'a Xtill' Chioza', daa na: “Daa wchell wṉe beṉ' c̱ho' bzoazi'yaagakan nad'.”

Na' yog' diika' na Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' bzejgake'n kwenc̱he wzajniin cho' na' wtipan lall'cho kwenc̱he gapcho yeḻ' chxenlall' lao diika' chen chle'icho na' goncho lez dii wenna' ba bc̱heb Chioza' c̱hecho.
Chioza', beena' choṉ cho' yeḻ' chxenlall' na' chtipe' lall'cho, gaklenshgue' le' soalen ljwell-le wen kon ka bli'yi Cristo Jesúza' cho',
kwenc̱he yog'le gakle toz we'la'ole Chioza', beena' nak X̱a X̱ancho Jesucrístona'.
Daan, ḻi wleb ljwell-le, ka ben Crístona' blebe' le' bénlene' txen, kwenc̱he koole Chioza' balaaṉ.
Na' nia' le', Crístona' bide' kwenc̱he gaklene' neto' beṉ' Israel, kon ka bc̱heb Chioza' lao dii x̱ozxto'nto'ka' kwenc̱he iṉezinto' chone' kon ka chc̱hebe'.
Na' ḻekzka' bide' kwenc̱he beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel we'la'ogake'ne' daa chiyesh'lallile' ḻegake'. Chak ka na Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' daa na:

content.text: Daan, we'lawaa li' ladj beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel,

content: Na' gan yoblə chiznan:

content.text: Le' bi nakle beṉ' Israel, ḻi yibaleni neto' naknto' yell c̱he'.

content: Na' ḻekzka' gan yoblə chiznan:

content.text: Yog'le le' bi nakle beṉ' Israel, ḻi we'la'o X̱ancho Chioza'.
Le' lle'le yog'te yell, ḻi goḻ iṉie'.

content: Na' ḻekzka' dii Isaíaza' bzeje' daa na:

content.text: Ka to yag dii chigaa, ka' yiyak xiiṉ dia c̱he dii Isaína',
daa galj to beṉ' iṉabi'e beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel,

content: Chios, beena' noncho lez gone' wen c̱hecho, gonshgue' ka yibaile na' soale mbalaz daa nonḻilall'lene, kwenc̱he zizikli gonchlene' lez daa zoalen yeḻ' wak c̱he Espíritu Sánto c̱he'na' le'.
Le' beṉ' bish'dawaa na' le' beṉ' zandawaa, ṉezyeṉid' ḻe beṉ' wen nakle na' ḻe ba chajniile, na' ba chak wzajnii ljwell-le.
Na' ḻee yishi ba biyaxjid' bzej' le' c̱he baḻ diika' bi chiyaḻ' guetlall'le, ḻa' chaklen Chioza' nad' kwenc̱he

chon' xshin Jesucrístona' ladj beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel. Na' llinni chon' nakan ka xshin bx̱oz, beena' chjwa' lao Chioza' diika' bibi nda' nchen. Ḻa' daa choe'len' ḻegake' dill' wen dill' kob c̱he'na' kwenc̱he gonḻilall'gake' Crístona', na' yix̱is yiyib Espíritu Sántona' yic̱hjlall'do'eka', na' gakgake' lall' na' Chioza', wak iṉacho nakgake' ka to dii bibi nda' nchen daa chzanid' wi'ane'.
Daa chaklen Cristo Jesúza' nad', chibaid' cho'a dill' chon' xshin Chioza' daa bene' lall' na'.
Aga wiyaxjid' wi'a dill' c̱he bichlə dii ba ben', san cho'a dill' ka ba bc̱hin Crístona' nad' kwenc̱he zan beṉ'ka' bi nak beṉ' Israel chzenaggake' c̱he'. Bc̱hine' diika' wnia' na' diika' ben'

kon yeḻ' wak c̱he Espíritu c̱he'na' kwenc̱he gok diika' ben ble'i beṉ' na' wyajḻe'gake'. Wzoloz' Jerusalénna' na' wya' ax̱t doxen gana' mbani Ilíricona' be'len' yog' beṉ' dill' wen dill' kob c̱he Crístona'.
Na' ben' byen jtix̱ji'a dill' wen dill' kob c̱he'na' gana' konoṉ' iṉezin, kwenc̱he bi jac̱hish' jaḻan' xshin beṉ' yoblə.
San kon ka na Cho'a Xtill' Chioza', gana' nan:

content.text: na' beṉ'ka' biṉ' yengakile' xtilleena', shajni'gakile'n.

content: Na' ni c̱he llin dga chon' biṉ' gak yid' gana' zoale, ḻa'kzi zan shii ba goklallaa yidwia' le'.
Per ṉaa ba biyoll ben' xshin Chioza' doxen gani chda', na' chakid' wak yidwia' le', ḻa' kana'te chaklallaa yid'.
Cheenid' tia' gana' zoale kat' sha' Espáñana', ḻa' cheenid' ile'id' le', ḻa'c̱h' shloll, kwenc̱he soacho mbalaz. Na' chbez' gaklenle nad' kwenc̱he gak kooch' nez.
Per ṉaa, yiyaa Jerusalénna' lljasan' dii chyallji beṉ' bish'choka' lle' na'.
Ḻa' beṉ'ka' choe'la'ogake' Crístona' Macedóniana' na' Acáyani do yic̱hj do lall'gake' ba btopgake' mech dii wseḻ'gake' c̱he beṉ' yesh'do'ka' len ladj beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Crístona' Jerusalénna'.

Do yic̱hj do lall'gake' chaklall'gake' gaklengake' ḻegake', na' dii ḻi nakan to dii chiyaḻ' gongake', ḻa' lengake' ba naki c̱hegake' dii wenka' ba bc̱heb Chioza' c̱he neto' beṉ' Israel, na' chiyaḻ' yigoogake' wzon c̱he beṉ' Israelka' we'gake' daa chyalljgakile'.
Na' ka yiyoll lljasan' mechi dga bengake' lo na', na' kwaa nez sha' Espáñana' na' tia' yidwia' le'.
Na' ṉezid' kat' yidwia' le', dii xen inlleb gaklen Crístona' cho'.

Le' beṉ' bish' na' le' beṉ' zan', daa nonḻilall'cho X̱ancho Jesucrístona' na' daa chon Espíritu Sántona' ka chaki ljwellcho, chat'yoid' le' gakle nad' txen iṉabgachile Chioza' gaklene' nad' lawi diika' chdiḻ chllag'.

Ḻi iṉabi Chioza' yisle' nad' lo na' beṉ'ka' bi chonḻilall'gake' Crístona', beṉ'ka' lle' gana' mbani Judeana', na' ḻekzka' ḻi iṉabile' sho'lall' bish' ljwellchoka' lle' Jerusalénna' dga lljasan' c̱hegake',
kwenc̱he zoa' mbalaz yidwia' le', shi Chioza' goṉe' latj, na' yiyakshao'lallaa daa soacho txen.
Na' Chioza', beena' chon ka zoacho mbalaz, soalenshgue' yog'le. Ka' gakan.
